hints.title: Vowel Filtering
hints.text: Filter out characters that match the five lowercase English vowels: a, e, i, o, and u.

hints.title: Collection Filter
hints.text: Store the vowels in a fast lookup set and keep only characters not in that set.

hints.title: String Construction
hints.text: Collect retained characters into a list and join them into the final output string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string concatenation inside a loop in some languages creates quadratic intermediate copies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering into a character buffer completes in single pass linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write idiomatic and clean string comprehension or stream filtering.
complexity.notes: Input contains only lowercase English letters.
